sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Ram Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Ram Kumar Singh, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Rishikesh Verma,
the learned A.G.A for the State and perused the record.

2.  The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
380 of 2022, under Section 406, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Imiliya Sultanpur, District Sitapur.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged on 30.09.2022 against one S.K.Chauhan, alleging that three persons had come to the informant about five months prior to lodging of the F.I.R and under allurement of getting him dealership of Shaktiman Urea, Rs.
80,000/- were taken from him through a bank draft in the name of Shaktiman Agritech.

The F.I.R.
stated that he was not made a dealer of the aforesaid brand and it appears that he had been duped.
4. In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., he reiterated the F.I.R version.

However, in his additional statement recorded on 15.03.2022, he stated that the applicant and some Vinod Kumar @ Vinod Kumar Awasthi vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98844462/
1 other persons were involved in cheating him.
5.

entities.text: Vinod Kumar @ Vinod Kumar Awasthi vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The applicant's criminal history of four cases has been explained in para no. 16 and 17 of the affidavit, in three of which he has already been granted bail.

6. It has been stated in the affidavit that the informant Dinesh Kumar Mishra had purchased some articles from the co-accused's firm Shaktiman Agritech for Rs. 80,000/- regarding which a cash memo was issued by Shaktiman Agritech on 02.06.2022.
7.

The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that co-accused Kuldeep Dixit, Pankaj Sharma, Navin Sharma and Ayush, have already been granted bail by means of orders dated 20.07.2023, 10.08.2023 and 27.07.2023 passed by this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Applications No.9129 of 2023, 6627 of 2023 and 8379 of 2023, respectively.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Applications No.9129 of 2023, 6627 of 2023 and 8379 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 8. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of the bail, but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.
Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

11. Let the applicant- Vinod Kumar @ Vinod Kumar Awasthi be released on bail in Case Crime No.
380 of 2022, under Section 34, 406, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Imiliya Sultanpur, District Sitapur, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Magistrate/Court concerned, subject to the following conditions: -
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
(ii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
(Subhash Vidyarthi,J.) Order Date :- 19.9.2023 Preeti.
